reason: The deal is clearly built to push me into a filter subscription, and I've been burned by those enough times that I won't start a new one for a gym bottle. Paying $49.99 plus $12.99 shipping to skip the plan puts it over $60, which is too much for a bottle filled from the gym fountain, and then I'd still have to wait 5-8 days.
objection: The real price only works if I sign up for a recurring filter plan, and 'cancel any time' is what every hard-to-cancel subscription says. Without the plan I'm paying $13 shipping on top of $50.
would_change_my_mind: Free shipping on the bottle alone with no plan, and filters I can buy one-off whenever I want, so I'm not locked into anything.
